top_deficiency_types.title: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.
Ensure that residents are free from significant medication errors.
Ensure therapeutic diets are prescribed by the attending physician and may be delegated to a registered or licensed dietitian, to the extent allowed by State law.
Ensure services provided by the nursing facility meet professional standards of quality.
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Provide enough food/fluids to maintain a resident's health.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Honor the resident's right to be treated with respect and dignity and to retain and use personal possessions.
Create and put into place a plan for meeting the resident's most immediate needs within 48 hours of being admitted
top_deficiency_types.category: Resident Assessment and Care Planning Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Let each resident or the resident's legal representative access or purchase copies of all the resident's records.
Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.
top_deficiency_types.category: Quality of Life and Care Deficiencies

top_deficiency_types.title: Protect each resident from all types of abuse such as physical, mental, sexual abuse, physical punishment, and neglect by anybody.
top_deficiency_types.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation Deficiencies
